summary: Containerized AAP stores the same operational secrets as Podman secrets, listed with `podman secret list` and kept base64-encoded (only obfuscated) in `$HOME/.local/share/containers/storage/secrets/filedriver/secretsdata.json` of the install user; `podman secret inspect --showsecret <secret>` shows a value. Monitor that file for unauthorized access.
questions: Where are secrets stored in a containerized AAP install?
How do I list Podman secrets for AAP?
How do I view the value of an AAP Podman secret?

answer_card.title: Inspect containerized AAP secrets
answer_card.answer_md:
Run as the user that installed AAP:
```bash
podman secret list
podman secret inspect --showsecret <secret>
```
They are stored base64-encoded (obfuscated, not encrypted) in `$HOME/.local/share/containers/storage/secrets/filedriver/secretsdata.json`. Monitor this file.
